description: This file defines the interface class IFactories within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. The class provides factory methods for creating proxy objects of various Web-related types, such as Request, Response, FileBody, and JSONRPC. It also includes static methods for managing a singleton instance of IFactories with functions to assign, retrieve, and check availability.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class that provides factory methods for creating web-related proxy objects within the Web namespace. It manages a singleton instance and ensures availability checks.
